title: 21.33. Hetuduka, Atītattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nahetu napaccuppanno dhammo hetussa paccuppannassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, anantare samanantare nava, upanissaye nava, natthiyā vigate nava.
